label: 磁力引擎 Kuaishou Magnetic Engine
terms_note: Register as a developer on the 磁力引擎开放平台, create an app, request permission packages (报表 / 账户 / 广告创编 / 人群), have advertisers authorize the app; Access-Token per advertiser. Rate limits: not readable. Free.

discovery.auth: oauth2 (app_id + secret → advertiser authorization → access_token; Access-Token header)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (Kuaishou Marketing API on the 磁力引擎开放平台).
auth: 1. Register as a developer at developers.e.kuaishou.com, create an application, request permission packages (report / account / ad management / audience).
3. Header `Access-Token` on every request; JSON body with `advertiser_id`.

endpoints.notes: campaign_id, unit_name, bid, bid_type, target{region, age, gender, interest}, day_budget, begin_time

reference.limits: - Rate limits: not readable (TODO(verify)). Developer registration + permission review; free API.

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: app_id returned when the 磁力引擎 MAPI developer application was approved (开发者平台 > 应用).

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: The application's secret; sent as `secret` in the refresh call.

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.help: refresh_token from 获取token (auth_code exchange after the advertiser authorised the app); valid 30 days and replaced on every refresh ('刷新后会生成新的 token，老的 access_token 和 refresh_token 将不可再使用'). Set PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR so the rotated token survives restarts.

config_fields.name: advertiser_id
config_fields.help: 广告主 ID returned with the access token at authorisation; used by the probe, update_budget and pause_resume.

adapter.terms: 快手磁力引擎 Marketing API (https://developers.e.kuaishou.com/docs?docType=DSP): JSON calls to https://ad.e.kuaishou.com/rest/openapi/… with an Access-Token header (valid 1 day); refresh with POST /rest/openapi/oauth2/authorize/refresh_token {app_id, secret, refresh_token} (token 有效期&续期: https://developers.e.kuaishou.com/docs?docType=DSP&documentId=2057). Answers {code (0 = OK), message, data}. Requires an approved MAPI developer app and advertiser authorisation.

me.note: No profile call takes a POST/query form, so the probe lists one campaign of the configured advertiser (POST /rest/openapi/gw/dsp/campaign/list, page_size 1).

list_campaigns.note: 查询广告计划 (POST /rest/openapi/gw/dsp/campaign/list {advertiser_id, page, page_size}): campaign_id, campaign_name, put_status (1 投放中, 2 暂停, 3 删除), status (1 暂停, 3 超预算, 4 有效, 5 删除, 6 余额不足), day_budget (厘, 0 = 不限), campaign_type, bid_type, create_time, update_time. The numeric status codes and the budget in 厘 stay in raw. status is not sent (put_status_list/status are numeric codes).

get_report.note: 广告计划数据 (POST /rest/openapi/v1/report/campaign_report {advertiser_id, start_date, end_date, campaign_ids?, temporal_granularity: DAILY, page_size ≤ 2000}): one row per campaign and day with stat_date, campaign_id, charge (花费, 元), show, photo_click, aclick, bclick, conversion metrics. Only the first 2000 rows are returned.

update_budget.note: 修改广告计划 (POST /rest/openapi/gw/dsp/campaign/update {advertiser_id, campaign_id, day_budget}) with daily_budget in 元 converted to 厘 (×1000); 0 means unlimited, otherwise ≥ 500 元, and a cut may not go below 120% of today's spend. Uses the configured advertiser_id. This spends money; currency is ignored (CNY).

pause_resume.note: 修改广告计划状态 (POST /rest/openapi/v1/campaign/update/status {advertiser_id, campaign_id, put_status}) with pause → 2 (暂停) and resume → 1 (投放); 3 (删除) is never sent. Partial failures are listed in data.errors. Resuming restarts spend.

not_offered.list_accounts: 拉取token下授权广告账户接口 (POST /rest/openapi/oauth2/authorize/approval/list, https://developers.e.kuaishou.com/docs?docType=DSP&documentId=1995&menuId=3797) takes 'app_id', 'secret' and 'access_token | 查询的 access_token' inside the JSON body; the runtime cannot put the token it minted into a request body, so the advertiser is configured as advertiser_id instead.

evidence: host ad.e.kuaishou.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.2 (GlobalSign nv-sa)
probe: 5/5 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
HTML docs spot-check: the docs pages did not render (login wall, SPA or bot wall)
